verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents settlement or reconciliation reports that match payouts to bank deposits, or that itemize fees, refunds, and chargebacks. The only related items are adjacent: an agent `list_transaction` tool, `get_merchant_insights` limited to ORDERS/SALES metrics, and separate refund and dispute APIs. None of these is a reconciliation capability, so the verdict stays at none.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks
